---
title: "Plot Alignment Window Preparation"
---

## Purpose

`PlotAlignmentWindowPreparation.hpp` is the Qt-free bridge between plot alignment state and the prepared-window `GatherResult` API.

It replaces plot-side use of `EventExpanderAdapter` and `IntervalWithAlignmentAdapter` with normal row metadata:

- `DigitalIntervalSeries` windows define the gathered rows.
- `DigitalEventSeries` alignment points define each row's trial-relative zero time.
- Optional overlap prevention prunes the window series and filters companion alignment points with the same kept row indices.

## Window Semantics

Plot window sizes are interpreted in physical display time units, matching the legacy plot adapter behavior. The helper materializes generated display windows in the gathered source `TimeFrame`, then passes those prepared windows to `GatherResult`.

This keeps cross-timeframe plots stable:

```text
alignment event or interval point
    -> physical alignment time
    -> physical display window
    -> source-TimeFrame DigitalIntervalSeries windows
    -> GatherResult(source, windows, alignment_points)
```

`alignmentTimeAt()` remains a physical time value for companion alignment events, so PSTH, event-rate, event plot, and line plot code can subtract it from physical event/sample times.

## Consumers

`PlotAlignmentGather.hpp` is now a compatibility layer around these helpers. It keeps the existing widget-facing functions while routing all aligned gathers through prepared windows.

`EventRateEstimation.cpp` includes this helper directly instead of including `PlotAlignmentGather.hpp`, preserving its no-QObject dependency boundary.
